description: This file defines React hooks and components for managing lock/unlock states of event type fields, including UI components like switches, badges, and tooltips, as well as internal logic for handling field states based on event type metadata.

methods.name: LockedSwitch
methods.description: A React component that renders a switch to lock or unlock a specific field, based on whether the event type is managed.

methods.name: LockedIndicator
methods.description: A React component that displays a lock/unlock badge with tooltip, indicating the lock state of a field.

methods.name: useLockedFieldsManager
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages lock states for event type fields, providing utility functions and components for UI and logic.
